roots: every subset of allocated object identifiers
precondition: all objects reachable from roots satisfy the policy
candidate_event: one value-changing field write followed atomically by zero or one root addition
enumeration_order: heap records lexicographic; root mask ascending; object ascending; field ready/value/next; value ascending; addition -1 then object ascending
exclusions: allocation, reclamation, callbacks, threads, exceptions, native mutation, bytecode, constructor histories
purpose: research-lock repair pilot; not the proposed 304-program benchmark
audit_design: After the discriminating pilot, replay every candidate in the separately implemented checker; no outcome-dependent selection. Frozen before complete-checker execution.
